code_path: external action subtraction: the frozen policy's action a is sent as a + c with c = -f_hat on the corrected channels; the policy network is not edited (the native action_out_proj/bias edit exists only in the ACE experiments)
gate_convention: full hold (chi=0): below the deadzone the innovation step is zero and f_hat is held
clipping_order: f_hat is updated, then projected onto the box [-clip, clip]^n; the correction is -f_hat times the channel mask; clipping precedes masking; the gripper is never corrected

units_per_channel.x: LIBERO OSC_POSE normalised action units (policy output space); measured motion is divided by OUT=[0.05 0.05 0.05 0.5  0.5  0.5 ] to the same units
units_per_channel.y: LIBERO OSC_POSE normalised action units (policy output space); measured motion is divided by OUT=[0.05 0.05 0.05 0.5  0.5  0.5 ] to the same units
units_per_channel.z: LIBERO OSC_POSE normalised action units (policy output space); measured motion is divided by OUT=[0.05 0.05 0.05 0.5  0.5  0.5 ] to the same units
units_per_channel.rx: LIBERO OSC_POSE normalised action units (policy output space); measured motion is divided by OUT=[0.05 0.05 0.05 0.5  0.5  0.5 ] to the same units
units_per_channel.ry: LIBERO OSC_POSE normalised action units (policy output space); measured motion is divided by OUT=[0.05 0.05 0.05 0.5  0.5  0.5 ] to the same units
units_per_channel.rz: LIBERO OSC_POSE normalised action units (policy output space); measured motion is divided by OUT=[0.05 0.05 0.05 0.5  0.5  0.5 ] to the same units

snapshot_application_rule: the policy returns a chunk; 5 actions are executed per chunk; the correction is recomputed and applied at every control step (tau_k = k, 20 Hz)

calibration.calib_episodes: all episodes of the healthy log

reset_protocol: libero-reset-v1 (libero_reset.reset_libero: forces cleared, cached env seeded per scenario, state fingerprint)
policy_seed: explicit schedule: fold_in(fold_in(key(sampler_seed), episode), call_index), re-issued at every episode start; per-episode seeds in episodes.csv
